What should I do if the tracking never updates?
Sorry about that—tracking can sometimes lag. Here’s what to try:
Give it a little time: After dispatch, it can take up to 24 hours for the first scan to appear on the carrier’s site.
Use the carrier’s page directly: Open the tracking link from your dispatch email, or copy the tracking number into the courier’s website/app and refresh.
Check your spam/junk: Make sure you’ve received the dispatch email with the correct tracking link and delivery date.
Look for delivery cards/safe places: Sometimes the parcel is delivered to a neighbour or left in a safe place without an immediate scan update.
When to contact us:
If there’s no movement 24 hours after the expected delivery date, or 48 hours after dispatch, reply here and we’ll investigate.

15:15
I’m sorry—let’s get this sorted. When tracking says delivered but you can’t find the parcel, please try:
Check the tracking page for a delivery photo, GPS pin, or a note about a safe place/neighbor/collection point.
Look around entrances, porches, bins, sheds, garages, and behind planters or fences.
Ask household members, neighbors, building management, or a concierge/reception.
If it was just marked delivered, give it a couple of hours—sometimes scans update before the driver finishes the round.
If it’s still missing after these checks, I can investigate right away and contact the courier. Please share:
If it’s a gift going to someone else, let me know the recipient name and delivery address so I check the right order. We’ll work on a replacement or a refund if it can’t be located.

Can I reroute the package to a different address?
It depends on where your order is in the journey.
If it has already shipped: A full address change is usually not possible. Some couriers may allow a diversion to a nearby pickup point or safe place, but this varies by shipment. I can check what’s available for your order.
If it hasn’t shipped yet: We may still be able to help before it leaves us. I’ll need to review your order status.
If you’d like me to check your options now, please share your order number and postcode. I’ll take a look right away and let you know what’s possible.

A free replacement delivery
A refund
Account credit
